_derivation_note: Hand-derived from the page's own stated radiometer equation (S_min = SNR * 2*k_B*T_sys/A_eff * sqrt(B_obs/(n_pol*tau)) in aperture mode, or SNR*SEFD*sqrt(B/tau) in SEFD-direct mode; EIRP_min = S_min(per Hz)*B_sig*4*pi*d^2), reimplemented independently in Node (not copied from the tool's compute()) and cross-checked to full float precision -- see OCS-FIXWAVE.md FW-4 board note. Case 1 is the tool's own default aperture-mode state (A_eff~6310 m^2, T_sys~20K matching the page's own '0.3mW at A_eff=6300,Tsys=20K' about-text example, scaled to 1e13 W EIRP at 10,000 ly) -- correctly not detected (SNR<10). Case 2 exercises the SEFD-direct branch at a much closer distance (10 ly) with 1e15 W EIRP, which clears SNR>=10 (detected=true). Both cases keep every numeric field (notably eirp_W and eirp_min_W) under Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER (2^53) so the page's own RFC-7493 assertIJson() guard does not degrade execution_hash to 'error' -- a pre-existing tool constraint (same one noted in the bz-kardashev FW-3 fixture), not something fixed here.
